name: New Door Ventures Employment Program
what_you_do: You can get a six month paid internship with employer partners, plus job coaching, if you are out of school or work.
who_can_apply: Ages 17 to 24. Aimed at 'opportunity youth' who are out of school or not working.
deadline_text: Applications accepted all year (per the sf.gov youth listing).
how_to_apply: Apply on the New Door intake portal linked from their site. The application link is on the official page.
notes: Mainly for 17 year olds and older who are not in a regular school path; not the usual fit for a student who is in school. Pay is not stated on the pages read.
